translations.text: And on that day I will break Israel’s bow in the valley of Jezreel.

And on that day I will make a covenant for them with the beasts of the wilderness, the birds of heaven, and the creeping creatures of the earth. I will destroy bow, sword, and battle from the land, and I will make you dwell securely.
And I will betroth you to myself forever. I will betroth you to myself in righteousness and justice, in mercy and compassion.
And I say to her, “You shall remain with me for many days. You shall no longer prostitute yourself, and you shall no longer belong to another man.”
And as it is with the people, so it shall be with the priest. I will exact vengeance from him according to his ways, and repay him according to his intentions.
They sought answers through lots, and with his rods they told him. In this way they were led astray into prostitution and prostituted themselves away from their God.
A city that does worthless things and stirs up the waters.
They are all adulterers, like an oven kindled for baking, blazing from the flame and from the lump of fat until it is leavened.
For their hearts blazed like a furnace when cursing them. All night Ephraim was filled with sleep. Morning came, and they blazed like a flame of fire.
Smash your calf, Samaria! My fury has flared up against them. How long will they be unable to cleanse themselves in Israel?
I will write many things concerning them, and his ordinances were regarded as foreign things.
For Israel forgot his Maker, and they built shrines. Judah multiplied fortified cities. I will send fire into his cities, and it will consume their foundations.
Even if they rear their children, they will be left childless among humankind. For woe to them! My flesh is from them.
For now they will say, “We have no king, because we did not fear the Lord. But what could a king do for us?”
Why did you [?] wickedness and [?] its lawless deeds? You ate the fruit of falsehood, because you trusted in your chariots, in the greatness of your strength.
A dishonest balance is in Canaan’s hand, and he loved to overpower others.
Samaria will be destroyed because she rebelled against her God. They will fall by the sword, their nursing infants will be dashed against the rock, and their pregnant women will be ripped open.
